_comment: The desktop app compiles THREE different things with different globals,
so this file only aggregates: `electron-vite` builds each target, and
Splitting them is not ceremony. main/ and preload/ run in Node and must
not see `document`; the renderer runs in a browser and must not see
`process`. One merged config let each half compile against the other's
globals, which is exactly how a `process.env` read ends up in renderer
code and fails only once the window is open.
